answer: Resist sybils with bonded loss insurance: every identity posts a loss bond into a shared vault before it may act — no atlas of standing without a deposit. Victims of misbehavior are paid from the offender's bond, so a canyon of damage costs the attacker its own locked capital, not the network's. Newcomers face actuarial pricing: no track record means high collateral ratios. Ten thousand sybils need ten thousand bonds frozen in karst-clear escrow, and one fraud by each forfeits everything. Each malicious act burns the attacker's own funds; honest agents reclaim their stake after clean epochs.
